notes.title: Boss Rush challenge update FINAL!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The final challenge update is here! Just in time for the hollidays! This last challenge is called Boss Rush! In Boss Rush you will have to go toe to toe with every boss from the Main Dream. Just watch out because one mess up will send you back to the start. Can you beat each boss without messing up? Find out today with the Boss Rush challenge update! 


This is the final update I have had planned for L.S.D. Maybe some day ill add more content if people ask but for now i need to move on to bigger and better things. The next game in the Lucid Dream series will be comming some time in 2023 if things go smoothly. I hope you all enjoy Lucid Dream Simulator! Come join the discord to get updates on the next game. The most ill say now is the title of the next game is L.D.S. Lucid Dream Shooter! Thats all for now and i hope you all have a great new year! Goodbye for now.

notes.title: WELCOME TO MAZE CRAZE!
notes.content:
Hello people! Today I gift you all with another free update! MAZE CRAZE! Maze Craze is the second part of the challenge update! This challenge brings you to a crazy maze full of wonder and mystery. Can you escape the maze? Find out TODAY! 

Update includes: 
- Maze Craze challenge update
-Few minor changes to Main Dream for quality of life
-Few minor changes to Mini Dream for quality of life

Other news: 
-Third challenge update expected to arrive Q4 2022,
-New title to be released 2023! 
-Clips of new game will be posted in the discord soon so join and take a look! 
-I got a new EUC and I am so stoked to ride it!


Dev note:
  Hope you all having fun with L.D.S. Now that challenge update 2 is done I can go back to development on my next game. Do not worry this will not stop more content updates to L.D.S. The new game is finally started to look good! I spent around 5 months making new concepts and scraping. Such a good feeling to be done with it and can just move on to developing rather then concept. I really hope you guys take a look and give me some feedback on the discord. This next title I really want to shoot for the moon and exceed all my expectations. Other then game news I got a new Electric Unicycle coming in the mail and I cant wait to ride the living balls out of it. Have a fun summer sale and hope you all enjoy the new update! Till next time!

notes.title: Challenge update number one!
notes.content: Hello everyone! We bring you the first of more updates to come called: "The Challenge" update! This update brings our first challenge, Tower! Tower is a series of challenges where failure may result in falling to the bottom and having to start over! These challenges are all new and will bring even more content to Lucid Dream Simulator. This update is mainly for our PC players but can still be played in VR. Stay tuned for more challenges to come! Enjoy the new content!
